statements.t: "In the third quarter, we again delivered positive results and, for the second time this year, raise our 2026 financial outlook," said Robert S.
Importantly, we expect our average 2026 customer bills to remain flat to last year."
• The Company raised its 2026 adjusted earnings per diluted share guidance to a range of $4.95 to $5.01, from a previous range of $4.89 to $4.95;

Based on strong operational performance, the Company raised its 2026 adjusted earnings expectations, with net income expected to be in the range of $313 million to $317 million, compared with its previously announced range of $310 million to $314 million.
These adjustments, net of applicable tax effects, are expected to recur as a result of the Company's regulatory framework and are a consistent part of our earnings profile.
